subject: Vendor onboarding & payment path — next steps (Klara Health)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@klarahealth.com>, Klara Health Procurement <procurement@klarahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding & payment path — next steps (Klara Health)

Hi Maya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so procurement has a clear path: 

Recap
- You’re evaluating Redwood to serve clinical-notes summarization for the intake flow (pilot scope: 250k tokens/month).
- Key procurement question: PO vs credit card for initial engagement and longer-term billing cadence.
- Marketplace option (Azure Marketplace) is of interest but you need to confirm internal approval for marketplace purchases.

Options we discussed
1) PO (preferred for larger deals) — standard AP onboarding + vendor form, Klara issues PO referencing SOW, Redwood invoices Net-30 by default.
2) Corporate card — faster for pilot; single payment to get started while PO processes.
3) Marketplace procurement — simplifies procurement for some customers but requires internal marketplace enablement.

What we need from you to move forward
- AP vendor packet / procurement form (if you can send the Klara AP policy or vendor sheet).
- Preferred payment method for the initial pilot (PO or card).
- Any required contract terms (payment net days, tax) or redlines up front.

Next steps (proposed)
- Maya: share Klara AP policy or the vendor form by EOD Friday so we can validate.
- Tessa (me): I’ll send an updated quote and the SOW that your procurement team can attach to the PO.
- Rishi: I’ll loop you in for any finance-level questions or exceptions.

Attachments: meeting-notes.txt (call notes), proposed-sow-draft.docx (SOW draft)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the updated quote once I have the vendor form.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: (meeting-recording.mp4 stub)

From: Maya Patel <maya@klarahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Klara Health Procurement <procurement@klarahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment path — next steps (Klara Health)

Thanks Tessa — good recap. Attaching our AP policy and the standard vendor packet (Klara_AP_policy.pdf). A few clarifications below: 

- For pilots <$50k we typically allow payment by corporate card to avoid delaying work. Anything above that route we prefer a PO.
- Our vendor onboarding usually takes 2–4 weeks after we receive a completed vendor packet + W9 + SOW/quote.
- We do use the Azure Marketplace sometimes but it needs sign-off from our vendor vetting team; that can add another week.

I’ve attached the AP packet and a short vendor questionnaire we typically ask (see attachments). Please confirm you can accept a PO referencing a signed SOW and invoice to billing@klarahealth.com.

Maya Patel
Head of Vendor Ops | Klara Health
Attachments: Klara_AP_policy.pdf, Klara_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@klarahealth.com>, Klara Health Procurement <procurement@klarahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment path — next steps (Klara Health)

Thanks Maya — got the packet, appreciate the clear timeline. Quick answers—

- Yes, we accept PO-based billing. Standard path: Klara issues PO referencing the signed SOW -> send PO + SOW to billing@redwood.com -> Redwood issues invoices per SOW payment schedule (Net-30 by default).
- For pilots we’re happy to accept corporate card to get started sooner; we can invoice for incremental usage if you convert to PO mid-pilot.
- Marketplace: if you want to go through Azure Marketplace we’ll coordinate with our partner ops, but that may delay initial start by ~1 week.

I attached an updated quote and SOW (redwood_quote_v2.pdf) with two SKUs — pilot and scaled option — so procurement can pick which path to reference on the PO. Also included a one-page vendor checklist to speed review.

Action items
- Maya: can you confirm whether you’ll issue a PO for the pilot or prefer card to start?
- Procurement: if you decide PO, please include the total contract value on the PO and the billing email (billing@klarahealth.com).
- Redwood: Rishi will help review any finance exceptions (e.g., Net-45).

Attachments: redwood_quote_v2.pdf (quote & SOW), vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Klara Health Procurement <procurement@klarahealth.com>, Maya Patel <maya@klarahealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment path — next steps (Klara Health)

Hi Maya / Procurement team — looping in as Redwood’s finance lead on this account. Quick note: 

- If you plan to issue a PO, please include the full contract amount and reference KLH-2027-1421 so our billing team can apply it directly.
- Billing email: billing@redwood.com.
- Our default is Net-30. If you need Net-45 or other terms, we can route an internal approval; please indicate that on the PO and we’ll flag the request.
- If you prefer to start on card, confirm the card holder and amount and we’ll provision access immediately.

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if procurement wants to run through the vendor packet together.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
Quick contact: rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
